Name: banlieue Azure disk encryption set reader
Description: For a Provider that sets spec.connection.azure.diskEncryptionSetId (ADR-0172 Decision 6): the one action ARM's linked access check requires of a caller that names a disk encryption set on a disk, snapshot, VM or gallery image version. Assign it on the disk encryption set itself, to both the runtime provider's and the image publisher's identities. Grants nothing on the Key Vault or the key.
